description: The whole shop, as a human player's shop screen shows it: the packs (sku, name, USD price, what each gives, and once logged in whether this account can buy it now and by which real-money methods: stripe = a card through a Stripe shared payment token, tempo = USDC on Tempo, x402 = USDC on Base), the limited-time sales on right now (buy with sale_id), the diamond shop (items bought with the game command shop.buy {sku} through send_command), and this account's store credit. Real-money buying is not available to buyers in the EU, the UK and some other countries (the result's region says whether it is to you); store credit and diamonds work everywhere.
name: shop_packs
title: List the shop
